source_055_failed_reason: Audit 055 required the induced action on the three nonidentity V4 elements to realize all of S3. The observed image has order 2 instead.
theorem_statement: The full 480-element automorphism group of native G60 normalizes the native V4. Its conjugation image in Aut(V4) is exactly C2: every automorphism fixes a, while 240 centralize b and ab and 240 exchange b with ab.
spectral_consequence: The chi_b and chi_ab Laplacian sectors are exactly isospectral because a native graph automorphism exchanges the two characters while preserving the G60 Laplacian.

interpretation.earned: The a direction is globally characteristic inside the native V4, whereas b and ab are indistinguishable under the full graph symmetry.
interpretation.failed_stronger_claim: The full S3 of permutations of {a,b,ab} is not realized.
